body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal D_{L,\kappa}\) with arm-cell vector \(\mu\), \(H_-(\mu)>0\) if and only if there exists \(d\in\{1,\ldots,L\}\) such that \(q_{0d}-q_{1d}>R_d-C_d\).
body.justification: The iff inequality turns a latent cross-world conclusion into an observable sorting-capacity certificate.
body.gap: Published probability-of-causation bounds and harm bounds across observed outcome categories, including de Aguas--Krumscheid--Pensar--Biele, do not provide a necessary-and-sufficient sorting-capacity condition for harm within latent stayers at protocol-assigned selection tiers.
body.consumer: An applied researcher can diagnose unavoidable harm layer by layer without solving a latent allocation problem.
